1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves a Dropdown component used to select icons. When a custom object is used as the selected item, and a custom rendering function (itemToElement) is used for list items, the selected value shown in the dropdown summary (closed state) is rendered as '[object Object]' rather than as the intended element/icon. 2.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves a Dropdown UI component that allows users to select icons as items. The dropdown functions visually, but when an icon is selected (e.g., a warning icon), the tooltip or HTML title on the dropdown trigger button displays '[object Object]' instead of a readable or graphical representation of the selected item. The underlying issue is that the dropdown incorrectly assumes 'itemToString' can serialize any item to a string for a11y labels and tooltips, but if the items are React elements (as in the icon case), this function fails, resulting in poor a11y and user experience. The request is to allow a configureable function (prop) to render the selectedItem, choosing between 'itemToElement' and 'itemToString'. The attached images showcase the dropdown in its normal and open states, and the tooltip issue ([object Object]) when hovering or focusing on the selected item.
